high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a flight reservation confirmation page from United Airlines. The background features a scenic view of the Chicago skyline during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, with a gradient of colors in the sky transitioning from light blue to orange and pink hues. Header: The top of the image displays "Reservation details" indicating that the flight information is being confirmed. Below the header, there's a banner with the text "Denver to Chicago," specifying the flight route.
